test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What factors contribute to the recognition of the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) as a significant reform in Indian higher education?

options.text: It mandates uniform subject selection and does not allow learners to choose subjects based on their interests
It integrates core subjects with skill-based courses for the holistic development of the students
It limits students to traditional academic disciplines and inhibits opportunities for innovation
It overlooks international standards and concentrates solely on indigenous educational practices

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 2: It integrates core subjects with skill-based courses for the holistic development of the students.***

 
 
• The passage identifies CBCS as a revolutionary framework because it **"offers a diverse array of courses, including interdisciplinary and skill-based ones, alongside core subjects."**
